name: bilibili-video-reader
description: Extract Bilibili multi-P metadata and official/AI subtitles through a live MCP server with automatic Browser Run fallback for cloud anti-abuse responses, then organize them into study notes, methods, questions, and code.

interface.shortDescription: Read Bilibili subtitles and multi-P videos
interface.longDescription: Connects ChatGPT to a read-only MCP backend for Bilibili video metadata and subtitles. Direct requests are attempted first; HTTP 412/429 automatically fall back to Cloudflare Browser Run.
defaultPrompt: 整理这个 B 站视频的字幕和方法。
把这个 B 站合集所有分 P 的题目和 Python 解法整理出来。
